device: Android API 36 emulator (AVD fm-members-frames, leased copy), wm size 412x915, density 160 (1 px = 1 dp), font_scale 1.3

builds.after: this branch head (Android room list recaptured with the desktop-only tap line in place)

method: Pixel analysis of the unedited screenshots with measure.py (PIL). Divider = last row of the 2 px full-width rule under the filter row (y=158-159). Label = first contiguous run of rows with ink (>60 RGB-sum difference from background) in the ROOMS label column x=16..90. Card top = first row below the label where the card border spans >90% of x=40..350. Distances count the background rows strictly between the two edges. Cross-checked against uiautomator bounds: ROOMS TextView [16,191][..,211] and first row [17,216][395,285] are identical on main and after.

rooms_header_desktop_1279x936_scale1.note: Main shows the + only in the desktop sidebar, inside a 44 px box that sets the header height. After keeps that 44 px line in the desktop sidebar only (tapLineHeight), while the + itself stays a 16x15 box with a 44 px tap area. The Android room list on main has no +, so there the + adds no height.

dom.source: the reviewer's browser measurement of main

rooms_header_desktop_1279x936_scale1.main_first_row_top_method: main's first row is read (untinted); pixel estimate is the second row's tint top (259) minus the 82 px row pitch, which gives 177. DOM bounds give 178 on both builds.
